summary: skill code-review at effort high over the full working-tree diff, before PR creation. One finding was in scope and is FIXED: validate_shiki.DISPATCH_MODES carried a "must stay set-equal to the schema enum" comment with nothing enforcing it - a new unbound pair introduced by a change whose purpose is removing unbound pairs. Fix: Pair16.test_holds_dispatch_mode_vocabulary_agrees_across_its_three_sites binds the schema enum, validate_shiki.DISPATCH_MODES and the shiki_cli --dispatch-mode choices by set-equality. Proven non-vacuous by mutation: adding "semi" to the schema enum and narrowing the CLI choices to ["afk"] each made it fail; the tree was restored and the suite re-run green. Three findings were recorded as out of scope for this task and changed nothing: cca_checklist_profile is judged from the HEAD task record but frozen by neither mergegate_check._NORMAL_PATH_GOVERNANCE_FIELDS nor _FROZEN_TASK_MATCH_FIELDS, so a PR could empty its own declared profile and drop enforcement; dispatch_mode is likewise unfrozen despite backing a blocking checklist row; and ISS-07 stays silent on whether an empty required_skills list is explicit. The first two need scripts/mergegate_check.py, which this task does not lock.
